rationale: Wan2.2 is a physical motion/video execution provider behind the existing FA3 Model Router, provider-admission and HRB boundaries. Provider admission, capability eligibility, resource admission and provider selection are deterministic authority-owned operations; this provider must not create a parallel semantic decision point or use Decision Fabric to expand the admitted candidate set.

project_radar_review.scope: Wan2.2 provider materialization against the existing FA3 Video, Model Router, HRB, provider-admission and Motion/Video execution boundaries
project_radar_review.note: Any bounded ranking among already eligible provider-execution candidates remains covered by the existing Model Router Provider Execution Decision Fabric assessment.
